source: NCh 430:2008 (ACI 318-08) with DS 60 (2011): the base pack's ACI 318-19 detailing with the DS 60 boundary element trigger of walls

sources.walls: DS 60 21.9.6.2: boundary elements where c ≥ lw / (600 δu/hw) with δu/hw at least 0.007 (ACI 318-19 18.10.6.2: lw / (600 × 1.5 δu/hw), δu/hw ≥ 0.005).
